title: 9 Best Herbal Creams For Dry Scalp
description: Rosmarinus officinalis creams, derived from the herb rosemary, have been traditionally used to treat dry scalp ailments such as dandruff and itchiness. The antifungal and antibacterial properties of this herbal preparation help to control the growth of yeast and fungi that contribute to the condition, while its anti-inflammatory properties soothe the irritated scalp.
